'''Thronda''' is a [[dwarf]] located at a home to the west of the [[Tower of Magilou]] in [[Northwind]]. Due to a mishap in an attempt to summon her own assembly of arcane elementals to help with her chores, Thronda and her master, [[Enchantress Magilou]], were forced to vacate the tower.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|30|Magilou's Magical Mishap}}</ref>
